checks.name: all-source-receipts
checks.detail: Unused receipts must also be current, canonical and company-scoped

checks.name: verified-final-root
checks.detail: Root and captured report must agree; cancellation cannot certify completion

checks.name: grounded-field-bound-claims
checks.detail: Every citation, topic and quoted value must match fresh independent readback; missing, stale, hostile and unrelated fields fail

checks.name: consistent-final-claims
checks.detail: Final quotations must not contradict one another

checks.name: corrective-research
checks.detail: Each observed contradiction needs new grounded evidence after detection; there is no expected recommendation

checks.name: specialist-reasoning-loops
checks.detail: Two separate specialists must plan/select capabilities and interpret later evidence in separate model turns; fixtures still do not establish model quality

checks.name: delegation-conservation
checks.detail: Every real child conserves reserved counts and belongs to this root; readbacks retain the delegated work scope

checks.name: delegation-and-synthesis
checks.detail: Real child goals plus final citations from independent sources; usefulness is independently reviewed

checks.name: safe-capabilities
checks.detail: Only company-scoped reasoners and frozen source reads; no business actions

checks.name: model-usage
checks.detail: Every successful provider attempt must disclose bounded usage and the pinned model

checks.name: verified-learning
checks.detail: Only current independently supported quotation cycles may enter scoped trusted memory

checks.name: uncertainty
checks.detail: Commercial inference remains distinct from verified source quotations
